## About
Ed's Transmission Northgate is a transmission shop on N Northgate Way in Seattle. Chuck and Dan work the front desk, and one reviewer calls them a comedic duo who will talk your ear off.
One customer described us as old school, honest and fairly priced, and another said we were transparent through the whole process. We hold a 4.7 rating from 55 Google reviews.
We're open Monday through Thursday. Give us a call or send Chuck an email and tell us what your car is doing.

## Services
- Transmissions: A longtime customer says not a single transmission we've done for him has come back.
- Transmission fluid leaks: A reviewer brought us a transmission fluid leak after another shop turned him away, and said we kept him informed the whole way.
- Used transmissions: When a reviewer's dealership had transmissions on back order, Chuck tracked down a used one and got the car running again.

## FAQ
Q: When are you open?
A: Monday through Thursday, 7:00 AM to 6:00 PM. We're closed Friday, Saturday and Sunday.

Q: What's your phone number?
A: Our phone number is (206) 525 - 2434.

Q: Will you look at a transmission another shop turned down?
A: Yes. One reviewer came to us after being turned away elsewhere, and we took on his transmission fluid leak.
